S01.notes: main: Origin page on first load: shows the hint under 'Country of origin' ('Start typing to search for a country.') and the hint under the region-code question.

S02.notes: main: accessible-autocomplete type-ahead with a magnifier icon; 'Fra' typed shows the France suggestion. With JavaScript off it is a native select. Plants origin uses the same component. Prototype: Without JS the country search is a plain text input with its search icon; there are no suggestions.

S03.notes: main: 'Yes' ticked to reveal the region-of-origin code field and its hint.

S04.notes: main: Revealed region code is a single text input; no separate country-prefix box. Without JS the conditional reveal is shown expanded. Prototype: The FR prefix box is filled in by JS once a country is picked. Without JS the revealed code field shows an empty grey prefix box.

S05.notes: main: Internal reference question at the foot of the origin page.

S06.notes: main: What are you importing? on first load (inset under H1).

S07.notes: main: Search box hint as rendered.

S08.notes: main: Main's commodity search is a server-side submit: typing 'Cow' shows no suggestions until Search is pressed (query-typed vs results). Works identically with JavaScript off. Prototype: With JS: grouped species checkboxes open under the box. Searched by name (cattle), code (0101) and Latin name (Bos). Without JS, typing shows no results and no species can be ticked (typed--nojs; the search button was not pressed).

S09.notes: main: H1 on main is already 'Main reason for import' (shot on a horse notification so every reason is offered).

S10.notes: main: Child search boxes under Transit and Temporary admission horses are accessible-autocomplete; 'Dov' typed into port of exit shows suggestions. Without JS they are native selects and every reveal shows. Prototype: Every child field under the reason radios is a native GOV.UK select (destination country, port of exit), not a search box. JS only toggles the conditional reveals. Without JS all the reveals show at once.

S11.notes: main: Exit date is the MOJ date picker (one d/m/yyyy text box plus calendar button), not the GOV.UK three-part date input. Calendar shown open. Without JS it falls back to a plain text box. Plants arrival date uses the same picker. Prototype: MOJ date picker: a text input plus a calendar button; calendar-open shows the dialog. Without JS it is a plain text input with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026'.

S12.notes: main: Spacing between the exit date picker and the port-of-exit field under Temporary admission horses.

S13.notes: main: Commodity details table before and after answering (Bos taurus, 2 animals).

S14.notes: main: Spacing above the 'Cow (0102)' commodity title.

S15.notes: main: Selected-commodities table on identification shows Commodity code, Common name and Number of animals; no Species column.

S16.notes: main: Identification page has no grey boxes: plain fields under an 'Enter details for Bos taurus 2 of 2' heading. Same page with and without JS. Prototype: The mobile shots are 390px viewport, full page.

S17.notes: main: After 'Save and add another' the saved animal's row (Bos taurus 1) appears in a table ABOVE the fields for animal 2. Prototype: In the prototype the saved-animal table sits inside the grey-headed panel, below the entry fields and the 'Save and finish' button.

S18.notes: main: The 'You have entered details for x ... Remove a record if you need to update it' line does not appear in this state on main (one of two animals added); main shows the table with a Remove link. The line may only appear once every animal is entered - not reached.

S19.notes: main: Arrival date hint shows an example date; MOJ date picker. Prototype: The hint uses a fixed example date, 27/3/2026.

S21.notes: main: Port of entry type-ahead with 'Abe' typed (suggestions open); native select without JS.

S22.notes: main: A native select cannot be screenshotted open. Main's options (from the controller): Airplane, Railway, Road Vehicle, Vessel. Prototype: A native select cannot be photographed open, so options-listed sets size=5 on the select in the page (DOM change for the shot only). The options are Select one, Air, Rail, Road, Sea.

S24.notes: main: Transit country type-ahead (accessible-autocomplete) plus 'Add country' button.

S25.notes: main: 'Bel' typed shows suggestions; picking and pressing Add country adds a row. Without JS: native select + Add country. Prototype: Each pick adds the country to a list under the box (one-country-added, two-countries-added). Without JS there are no suggestions.

S26.notes: main: Transporter search is a plain text input plus secondary Search button (server-side, works without JS). Prototype: The transporter search filters the table on the client (filtered-aber). The no-JS shot shows the page as it loads, with nothing filtered.

S27.notes: main: 'Add a transporter' secondary button sits below the transporter table, above Save and continue.

S28.notes: main: Date of issue is the MOJ date picker; text box only without JS.

S29.notes: main: Documents page with nothing uploaded: 'You have not added any documents yet.' shows inside the File upload card under Save and add another. The same line also shows on the review page's Uploaded documents card (see S34 shots).

S31.notes: main: After uploading a PDF with 'Save and add another' and waiting for 'Check completed', the uploaded table sits inside the File upload card below the form, columns Document reference / type / Date of issue / Status, with View file and Remove. Prototype: Shot with two documents added. Each status shows 'Scanning for virus' because the shot is taken before the prototype's 2.5s fake virus check completes.

S32.notes: main: Consignment addresses, empty and with all five parties and no CPH yet.

S33.notes: main: Place of origin picker search: plain text input + secondary full-width Search button, server-side; identical without JS. Prototype: Covers place of origin and consignor. The filter runs on the client.

S34.notes: main: Main shows red left border, a red 'Complete ...' message and a red dash per missing answer on every incomplete card. Plants shows the left border and message but 'Not provided' instead of red dashes. Prototype: The prototype review also marks incomplete cards with a red left border and red 'Complete ...' text, and shows an error summary on first load.

S35.notes: main: Continue on an incomplete review lands on ?refused=1 with an error summary. Clicking the first error link ('Complete reason for import') stays on the review page (in-page anchor) rather than going to the question. Prototype: Continue on an incomplete review re-renders the same page with the error summary. first-error-link-followed is the page after clicking the first summary link.

S36.notes: main: Address pickers are a radio table with a 'View details' details (expander) per row. At 390 wide the table overflows: the full-page shot renders 476px wide. Prototype: Each address picker is a radio table (name, address, country, View), with no accordion. At 390px the table is wider than the screen: the full-page shot is 472px wide because the page scrolls sideways.

S37.notes: main: Typing '123456789' after clicking County leaves '12' in County (maxlength 2) and the focus there; the cursor does not move on to Parish. Same without JS. Prototype: With JS, focus moves to the next box after 2 then 3 digits. Without JS each box stops at its maxlength and focus stays in the county box (typed-continuously--nojs shows only '12').

S38.notes: main: Declaration page and the 'Import notification submitted' page after a full walk. Prototype: Full cattle-by-air walk: complete review, declaration, then the submitted page.

S30.notes: Prototype: Not shot: the designers say no action is needed (snags.json designersSayNoAction).
